personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (Customized for Tech Cyber Gold)
personality_one_liner: A commanding, cinematic dark-mode experience dripping in cyber gold, designed for high-performance marketing and affiliate tracking.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic spacing. Use 'md' or 'lg' between form elements, '2xl' for section breaks. Tappable areas minimum 44x44pt. Strict RTL adherence (padding-right for leading elements).

do's: Use heavy glass on the FAB and sticky bottom CTAs
Use subtle glass effect over 'brandTertiary' tint for the top segmented pill toggle
Apply glassmorphism to the QR code / referral link floating card in the Affiliate Dashboard
dont's: Do not use glass on form inputs or dense lists

screens.name: MerchantMarketingHome
screens.purpose: Central hub for merchants to view and manage their Ads and Affiliates.

states.empty: Glassy card with gold abstract illustration, text: 'لا توجد حملات حالياً' (No campaigns currently), and a 'إنشاء حملة' (Create Campaign) button.

screens.layout: RTL Layout. Top: Glassy segmented control [إعلانات ↔ مسوّقون] (Ads / Affiliates). Ads Tab: Vertical list of active campaigns (Regular Ads). Affiliates Tab: Top horizontal scroll of pending applications, followed by a vertical leaderboard list of top-earning affiliates. Bottom right: Heavy glass FAB with gold icon for 'New Campaign'. FAB opens a Bottom Sheet type picker.

screens.name: NewCampaignFlow
screens.purpose: A unified flow to create either a Regular Ad or an Affiliate Campaign.

states.loading: Gold spinner inside CTA button during save
states.error: Inline red text below failed fields

screens.layout: RTL Layout. Type Selector Modal: Two large glassy cards (Regular Ad vs Affiliate Campaign). Once selected, opens full-screen scrollable form. For Regular Ad: Title, Description, Image (with 1080x1080 preview aspect ratio), Target Cities (Chip group picker), Gender (Pill segmented control: الكل, رجال, نساء), Interest Tags (Chip selector), Starts/Ends dates. No budget field. For Affiliate Campaign: Includes all above + large Commission % Slider (with bold numeric readout), Incentives text area. Sticky bottom container with 'surfaceSecondary' glass background holding a full-width 'brandPrimary' (Gold) CTA button.

screens.name: CustomerSocialFeedCard
screens.purpose: Customer-facing social feed item showcasing merchant campaigns with high conversion CTAs.
screens.layout: RTL Layout. Lighter customer theme base but with 'brandTertiary' (Gold) subtle borders for affiliate cards. 1:1 or 4:5 Aspect Ratio Image taking full width of the card. Mandatory vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) at the bottom. Overlay Text: Title and description anchored bottom-right. Bottom-left: Big 'brandPrimary' (Gold) CTA button (e.g., 'قدّم الآن' or 'تسوق الآن').

screens.name: CustomerAffiliateApply
screens.purpose: Frictionless application form for customers to join an affiliate program.
screens.layout: RTL Layout. Dark modal. Header: Merchant Logo and 'انضم كمسوّق' (Join as Affiliate) title. Content: Auto-filled fields (Name, Phone, City) shown as disabled/dimmed inputs. Missing fields (Social handle, Audience size) highlighted with 'borderStrong' gold outlines. Bottom: Sticky gold CTA 'تقديم الطلب' (Submit Application).

screens.name: CustomerStoreTabWithPill
screens.purpose: Store tab that injects a top segmented toggle when the user is an approved affiliate.
screens.layout: RTL Layout. Absolute top center (respecting safe area): Floating pill segmented control [🛍 المتجر ↔ 🏆 المسوّق]. Active state uses 'brandPrimary' background with 'onBrandPrimary' text. Inactive uses translucent 'surfaceSecondary'. Tapping 'المسوّق' cross-fades the screen into the CustomerAffiliateDashboard.

screens.name: CustomerAffiliateDashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for approved affiliates to track earnings and get referral links.
screens.layout: RTL Layout. Dark Cyber Gold theme. Top: Merchant logo + Name. Hero Section: Glassy card displaying 'Total Earnings' with a large gold count-up numeric font. Below Hero: 'رابط التسويق الخاص بك' (Your Referral Link) card containing the URL, a mini QR code button, and a large 'نسخ' (Copy) icon button alongside WhatsApp share. Middle: 2x2 grid of analytics (Clicks, Visitors, Pending, Paid) using 'surfaceSecondary' cards. Bottom: 'Withdraw' gold CTA (if balance > threshold) and 'سجل الأرباح' (History List) showing recent conversions with timestamp and amount.

hero_abstract_bg.alt: Cyber gold abstract dark circuit background

api_contract.POST /api/marketing/campaigns: Payload: { type: 'ad'|'affiliate', title, description, image_url, target_cities: [], target_gender: 'all'|'male'|'female', target_interests: [], starts_at, ends_at, commission_pct (optional), incentives (optional) }. Response: 201 Created.
api_contract.POST /api/marketing/affiliate-apply: Payload: { merchant_id, campaign_id, social_handle, audience_size, note }. Response: 201 Created (status: 'pending').
api_contract.PUT /api/marketing/affiliate-approve/:ap: Payload: { status: 'approved' }. Response: 200 OK (Creates referral code & updates user flag).
api_contract.GET /api/marketing/affiliate-dashboard/:: Response: { total_earnings, pending_commission, referral_link, qr_code_url, analytics: { clicks, unique_visitors, conversions }, history: [{ order_id, amount, date }] }

state_flow: 1. Customer Taps 'Apply' -> 2. Application status = 'pending' -> 3. Merchant reviews & Approves -> 4. System flags user as affiliate & generates code -> 5. Customer UI unlocks 'المسوّق' toggle on Store tab -> 6. Customer accesses Dashboard.
motion_notes: Use gold shimmer effects on the 'Total Earnings' card in the dashboard. Slide-in animation for the Store top toggle pill. Count-up Reanimated effects for analytics grid numbers.
instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow RTL layout guidelines for Arabic text and icon placement (icons generally on the right, text right-aligned).
Use Cairo for headings and Tajawal for body text.
Ensure 'Tech Cyber Gold' styling is dominant. Background must be #0A0A0A (Midnight Obsidian) with Gold (#F5C518) accents. Avoid generic blues entirely.
For the Customer Social Feed Card, always overlay a gradient scrim (transparent to dark) behind the text and the gold CTA to guarantee contrast against the image.
Implement the Top Pill toggle ([🛍 المتجر ↔ 🏆 المسوّق]) as an absolute-positioned floating glass pill at the top of the Customer Store tab.
In the Affiliate Dashboard, emphasize the 'Total Earnings' and 'Referral Link' cards using glassmorphism (`expo-blur`) over a dark tint.
Use Reanimated to implement a count-up animation for the commission/earnings numbers.
Build a reusable component for the Campaign Form that conditionally renders the Commission/Incentives fields based on the selected type (Regular vs Affiliate).
